notes: Modal share panel. Trigger opens native <dialog> with social links + copy-link input. Platforms loaded from BRAND_CONFIG.sharing.platforms by default — override via platforms prop. Composes Button, Icon, Link, Heading, Text atoms.

url.description: The page URL to share. Encoded into platform share links.

title.description: Dialog heading and share text for platforms that accept a title.

platforms.description: Override brand-default platforms. Each entry: name, shareUrl template ({url} and {title} replaced), icon (Phosphor name), svg (custom markup), color (CSS token for icon bg).

class.description: Additional CSS classes on the root element.
